signatures.description: Implement a register allocator for an SSA-form IR on a target with K registers: build interference graphs from live intervals, then perform live-range splitting with second-chance binpacking so a loop-heavy hot path avoids spills while the cold path absorbs them. The allocator must be optimal for straight-line code and must resolve the classic correctness trap where a split range is reloaded into a different register inside a dominance tree, invalidating phi-node location mappings. Output must include spill cost accounting within 5% of an oracle allocator on a generated benchmark corpus.
